question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**covered**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of the passage, the phrase*** "peaks covered by a thin layer of snow"*** indicates that the mountain peaks are coated or concealed by a thin layer of snow. The word "**covered**" accurately describes the condition of the mountain peaks in relation to the snow.
 
• Meaning of other options:
 
 
• **Filled**: To occupy or pervade a space completely. While the snow may fill the space on the mountain peaks, the word "**filled**" doesn't specifically convey the idea of the snow layer covering the peaks.
 
• **Piled**: To accumulate in a heap or mound. While snow can accumulate in piles, the word "**piled**" doesn't convey the idea of the snow layer uniformly covering the peaks.
 
• **Spread**: To extend over a surface or area. While the snow may indeed spread over the peaks, "spread" doesn't convey the sense of the snow layer directly covering the peaks in the same way as "**covered**" does. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, "**covered**" is the most appropriate option to describe the state of the mountain peaks in the passage.

 

Correct Passage:__ *The expansive landscape stretched as far as the eye could see, its vastness seeming endless. Majestic mountains towered in the distance, their peaks **covered** by a thin layer of snow. A gentle breeze whispered through the (3)__________ trees, rustling their vibrant leaves. The air (4)_______ the sweet fragrance of the flowers, filling the surroundings with a delightful aroma. As the sun began to set, the sky transformed into a radiant canvas, painted with (5)______ of orange, pink, and gold.*
